other_lag.statement: other_lag: not exercised (no sequential call where the answer decides the verdict); the pinned dogwood binary, one trace per writer (Dogwood's host keeps one trace per scope; a second writer of one scope is the same trace, so other_lag has no writer to probe); one host replays its whole trace per decision, so there is no second writer whose writes it could miss (N203)
